correctness.rationale: A missing interior ℓ-mer produces at most one overlap-defective adjacency; weak compatibility across a single defect uniquely determines its parent, and two defects are impossible. With all pairs compatible there is a unique length-(n-1) word z; 2q endpoint extensions (2q-1 for constant z) and one distinct extension per long strictly internal constant run establish the exact lists. Run-length compositions give the rational generating function, and disjoint witness blocks give the maximum 2q+floor((n-3)/(ℓ-1)). The defect-vector term t(q^n-q^(n-ℓ+1)), t=n-ℓ-1, follows by injection; independent enumeration for 5 small q,ℓ,n triples matched compatibility and list extrema.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks do not replace all-parameter reasoning.

originality.rationale: The published 2026-10-27 result Exact inverse-list distribution for one deleted overlapping read is exactly the same unpadded ordered complete-ℓ-mer channel with same q,ℓ,n assumptions. It gives the same 2q-1 constant case, 2q+J_{ℓ-1}(z) internal-run case, singleton inconsistent cases, maximum and complete rational histogram. The new generator is algebraic rearrangement of the prior run polynomial, no new inverse spectrum.
